record.context_brief: Directed Feedback Vertex Set on planar digraphs
record.original_question: For the Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem on planar directed graphs, where the input is a directed graph G and a positive integer k and the task is to decide whether there exists a set S of k vertices such that every directed cycle of G contains a member of S, does there exist a fixed-parameter algorithm whose dependence on k is single exponential?

evidence.quote: Question: Is there a set S of k vertices such that each directed cycle of G contains a member of S?
It remains open if there exist a single exponential algorithm for Directed Feedback Vertex Set even on planar graphs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a planar directed graph and let k be a positive integer. The Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem asks whether there exists a set S ⊆ V with |S| ≤ k such that every directed cycle of G contains at least one vertex of S. A parameterized algorithm for this problem (parameterized by k) is said to be single exponential in k if it decides the problem in time 2^{O(k)} · n^{O(1)}, where n = |V|.

Question: Does there exist a fixed-parameter algorithm for the Directed Feedback Vertex Set problem on planar directed graphs whose running time is single exponential in the parameter k, that is, of the form 2^{O(k)} · n^{O(1)}?
artifact.category_tag: Parameterized complexity / Directed Feedback Vertex Set
artifact.status_search_result: A web search shows that whether Directed Feedback Vertex Set admits a single-exponential FPT algorithm 2^{O(k)} n^{O(1)} (parameterized by solution size) is still listed as a challenging open problem in parameterized complexity, even on general digraphs; the best known FPT running time is of the form 4^k k! n^{O(1)} (Chen et al.). No source found reports a single-exponential FPT algorithm in k specifically for the planar restriction. Known improvements for planar DFVS concern parameterizations by treewidth (2^{O(t)} n^{O(1)}) rather than by solution size k.

status_evidence.title: A Simplified Parameterized Algorithm for Directed Feedback Vertex Set
status_evidence.snippet: Whether DFVS allows a single-exponential parameterized algorithm is still a challenging open problem in parameterized complexity.
status_evidence.claim: Existence of a single-exponential FPT algorithm for DFVS remains open.

status_evidence.title: On Directed Feedback Vertex Set Parameterized by Treewidth
status_evidence.snippet: On planar digraphs DFVS parameterized by treewidth t is solvable in 2^{O(t)} n^{O(1)}.
status_evidence.claim: Single-exponential results for planar DFVS exist for the treewidth parameterization, not for solution size k.

status_evidence.title: Feedback vertex set - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Chen et al. gave an algorithm with running time 4^k k! n^{O(1)} for DFVS.
status_evidence.claim: Best-known FPT algorithm for DFVS is not single exponential in k.
